description: Main source file for Zephyr-based logging subsystem demo, demonstrating module and instance filtering, severity levels, transient string logging, performance testing, and external log system integration.

methods.name: timestamp_get
methods.description: Returns current cycle count for timestamping.

methods.name: timestamp_freq
methods.description: Returns hardware clock cycles per second.

methods.name: module_logging_showcase
methods.description: Demonstrates module-level logging filtering and enabling/disabling logs.

methods.name: instance_logging_showcase
methods.description: Demonstrates instance-level logging filtering and log level adjustments.

methods.name: severity_levels_showcase
methods.description: Logs messages at different severity levels.

methods.name: log_transient_string_showcase
methods.description: Logs a transient string to demonstrate logger copying.

methods.name: wait_on_log_flushed
methods.description: Waits until all buffered logs are processed.

methods.name: log_demo_supervisor
methods.description: Sets timestamp function and starts demo thread, handles user/kernel mode.
